case_verdicts.reason: Canonical Git loose header and SHA-1 identity combine with genuine native zlib encode/decode and a fixed valid stored-block input. Encoded compressed bytes are not fixed.
Compound five-mode tree encoding uses Git directory-aware byte ordering, exact literal bytes/OID, caller order preservation, parsed modes/names and referent kinds.

Canonical commit parent order, author/committer time offsets, repeated custom headers and module-defined message normalization agree with literal bytes/OID; continued headers preserve exactly one of two leading spaces.
One valid delta mixes literal insertion, the legal omitted-size 65,536-byte copy, a nonzero-offset copy and final insertion; exact output, digest and unchanged base are fixed.

Complete four-type pack building is checked through joined fixed header/trailer and full decoding to literal objects, separately from an independent complete golden pack. No exact output chunk partition is required.
A complete base-to-OFS-to-REF chain exercises the two-byte backward offset and caller-retained intermediate resolution in documented pack order, with exact objects and final trailer completion.

production_module.OS_scope: Actual pinned component source. No full OS, storage workflow, security, performance or durability claim.

intended_contract_sources.supports: Loose-object header/hash construction and commit tree/parents/identity/message format; fixed short book blob vector.
Five ordinary tree entry modes and their file, symlink, directory and gitlink meanings.
Only the ordinary multi-line object-header layout: continuation prefix and preservation of an originally empty value line. No signing or verification behavior is tested.

Version-two pack header/count, object type/size encoding, SHA-1 trailer for this traditional-hash codec, copy/insert delta instructions, omitted zero copy size meaning 65536, and OFS backward-offset arithmetic.

intended_contract_sources.source: Unchanged production module documentation and source
intended_contract_sources.supports: Canonical tree ordering, module-defined commit normalization, caller-supplied base retention and one-pass pack order. Source alone does not justify incidental encoder chunk boundaries.

golden_validation.method: Independent fixed-byte arithmetic and hashing, with no fixture, decoder, Git or JS/TS execution by reviewers. Golden JSON and JS literal module agree.

distinctness: Compared actual baseline S/X/B/C/D and new K/Y/F bodies. Native compression, SHA, BYOB, stream chunking, cloning, storage conversion and reused cleanup are supporting mechanisms only. Six credits correspond to Git-specific loose/tree/commit/delta/pack/base-resolution contracts, not a mode/size/chunk grid.
fixture_resource_review: An ordinary direct-celld fetch handler admits exactly one case per fresh owned deployment/process; no DO, RPC, service binding, storage, capability or external network path is used.

Fixed owned valid bytes, literal lengths and finite loop/read/source/assertion/operation caps constrain all cases. Real native builtins and the exact imported module are required; no substitute codec or altered production source is supplied.

Each yielded base is retained before the next generator request. Success requires the extra final next() to finish exact object count and trailer/EOF verification. A finally block calls return() and clears retained bases.

Normal finite byte sources must close once with their exact full byte count. Private production BYOB/digest ownership is not exposed or rewritten; generator completion and source closure are observations, not proof of lock/native reclamation.

The original trace promise must settle; an unsettled trace cannot trigger racing in-process cleanup. Every result still requires independently bounded teardown of all proven-owned runtime/dev/bundler descendants across PGIDs and their staging/temp/log/bundle/store files.

A logical decoded-payload estimate is explicitly not a JS heap measurement. The full domain requires an enforced 512 MiB aggregate RSS bound; receipts are capped at16 KiB and contain no large byte arrays.

limits.memory_accounting: Decoded logical payload estimate only; no JS heap or native allocation measurement. Hex strings, temporary values, pako/native state and allocator overhead are bounded solely by the mandatory owned-domain RSS ceiling.
limits.descendant_supervision: Entire proven-owned runtime/dev/bundler domain including descendants across PGIDs; no single-process-group assumption.

review_findings_resolved: Removed X205 exact 10-chunk encoder topology and fixed output indexing, replacing them with joined format/trailer checks and both built/golden full decoding.
Strengthened the valid X203 continuation to two leading spaces so removal of exactly one is discriminating.
Replaced the unsupported 1 MiB heap-vector claim with a scoped logical-payload estimate and simplified unhex to one bounded typed-array loop.

source_compatibility_caveat.evidence: crates/celld/js/modules.rs:546 and harness.js:11562–11578; pinned native zlib backing is present
source_compatibility_caveat.finding: The harness lacks constants.Z_BEST_SPEED and ignores sync compression options. These tests retain valid-format oracles but cannot establish the OS encoder's requested fastest compression level or performance. No shim, fallback, source fix or expected-failure exemption is introduced.

independent_static_verification.author_validator_note: Reviewed as source only because it includes Python zlib.decompress on fixture vectors; reviewers instead checked literal wrapper arithmetic/hashes and ran their own hash/AST/Node --check-only checks. No reference decoder executed by reviewers.

remaining_runtime_prerequisites: Separately authorized trusted exact binary/build and bundler/config/module identity.
Exact integrity-verified pako3.0.2 package, license/notices and full installed graph; package declaration/lock text alone is not package-byte verification.
Faithful TS type erasure/using disposal and genuine celld nodejs_compat/native modules.
Complete enforced budgets, owned-domain identity and independently recorded successful teardown.
qualification: All six designs remain UNRUN. Static vector/syntax/integrity review does not establish actual module execution, runtime success, full OS behavior or production readiness.
